proposals.title: Field-service reflash to replace bootloader and install ML-DSA firmware
proposals.rationale: The blocking REQ-BOOT-S0S1 is caused by the declared transition requiring bootloader self-update, which is unsupported on this board. The field-service plan replaces the bootloader via the debug port during a maintenance window, avoiding the unsupported self-update path. This also provides a controlled environment to address the unknown invariants INV-I2 and INV-I4 by performing the update with stable UART and observing the non-atomic window.
preconditions: Physical access to the device debug port
Stable UART connection for interruption testing
Ability to capture and verify the update state after interruption
tradeoffs: Requires manual intervention, not suitable for remote or large-scale deployment
Does not address the dual-signature invariant INV-I3
evidence_still_needed: E10 event-based interruption with stable UART
E12 interrupted update with observed recovery

proposals.title: Staged hybrid bootloader with dual-signature verification
proposals.rationale: The invariant INV-I3 is unknown because the dual-signature build failed and the AND/OR behavior was not observed. This plan ships an intermediate bootloader that verifies both ECDSA and ML-DSA signatures, directly addressing the dual-policy gap. It also provides a staged transition that may reduce the risk of interruption (INV-I4) by keeping the old signature valid during the transition.
preconditions: A working dual-signature build on the pinned commit
Ability to test the AND/OR signature verification matrix
tradeoffs: Requires a successful dual-signature build, which previously failed
Does not address the bootloader self-update requirement REQ-BOOT-S0S1
evidence_still_needed: E10 event-based interruption with stable UART
E12 interrupted update with observed recovery

local_assistant.content: The migration verdict is **INCOMPATIBLE** because the declared transition plan requires a bootloader self-update, which is unsupported on this board as evidenced by [EV-E11-SELF-UPDATE] and violates requirement [REQ-BOOT-S0S1] for both transition steps [STEP-S0-S1] and [STEP-S1-S2].
